facts.text: The hotel is in Ho Chi Minh City's District 1, steps from the Saigon Opera House and Nguyen Hue Walking Street.
facts.excerpt: Perfectly situated in Ho Chi Minh City's District 1, steps from the Saigon Opera House and Nguyen Hue Walking Street

facts.text: The hotel is at the junction of Dong Khoi Street and Dong Du Street, steps from the Opera House Station on Line 1 Metro.
facts.excerpt: ideally situated at the junction of the legendary Dong Khoi Street and Dong Du Street, next to Nguyen Hue Walking Street, just steps from the Opera House Station on Line 1 Metro

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office.
facts.excerpt: Our prime location places you within walking distance of iconic landmarks like the Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and Central Post Office

facts.text: Grand Opera Tower is a hotel within a hotel: a luxury wing of the hotel with its own lift lobby and The Salon, a private lounge for Grand Opera Tower guests.
facts.excerpt: Grand Opera Tower is a luxury hotel within a hotel: the 120-room luxury wing of Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel, with its own lift lobby and The Salon, a private lounge for Grand Opera Tower guests.

facts.text: The Salon serves breakfast, afternoon tea, evening cocktails and all-day refreshments for Grand Opera Tower guests.
facts.excerpt: The Salon: breakfast, afternoon tea, evening cocktails, all-day refreshments for Grand Opera Tower guests

facts.text: Grand Opera Tower guests arrive through a lift lobby framed by a living vertical garden and check in at The Salon rather than the main lobby.
facts.excerpt: Arrive through a lift lobby framed by a living vertical garden, and check in quietly at The Salon rather than the main lobby.

facts.text: Grand Opera Tower rooms are inspired by the neighbouring Saigon Opera House and Vietnamese craftsmanship, with lotus motifs, quatrefoil doors and mother-of-pearl inlay.
facts.excerpt: Each is inspired by the neighbouring Saigon Opera House and by Vietnamese craftsmanship, expressed in lotus motifs, quatrefoil doors and mother-of-pearl inlay.

facts.text: Every Grand Opera Tower room includes a wellness kit for yoga and stretching.
facts.excerpt: Every room includes a wellness kit for yoga and stretching

facts.text: The hotel's rooms are decorated with lotus motifs celebrating Vietnam's national flower.
facts.excerpt: Our accommodations are adorned delicate lotus motifs that celebrate Vietnam's national flower

facts.text: Rooms have views over Nguyen Hue Walking Street or the Saigon River.
facts.excerpt: offer airy spaces with beautiful and stunning views over Nguyen Hue Walking Street or the Saigon River

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is on the 21st floor.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the 21st floor, the Presidential Suite is the epitome of luxury

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has three bedrooms, each with an ensuite bathroom.
facts.excerpt: This exquisite suite features three spacious bedrooms, each with an ensuite bathrooms

facts.text: The fifth floor is the hotel's wellness level, with a heated saltwater pool, Sheraton Fitness and Evolve Wellness Center.
facts.excerpt: The fifth floor is the hotel's wellness level: a heated saltwater pool, Sheraton Fitness (5:30 am to 11 pm), Evolve Wellness Center

facts.text: The heated outdoor pool's water is kept at 29 degrees year-round.
facts.excerpt: Bask in the warmth of 29-degree water year-round

facts.text: The pool has cabanas for lounging poolside.
facts.excerpt: simply wish to lounge poolside in our stylish cabanas

facts.text: Hai Bar is a rooftop cocktail bar on Level 23, designed for sunset drinks and skyline views.
facts.excerpt: Hai Bar is a rooftop cocktail bar on Level 23, designed for sunset drinks, skyline views and refined nights above Saigon.

facts.text: Li Bai restaurant serves Cantonese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: This downtown Ho Chi Minh City restaurant features authentic Cantonese delicacies curated by seasoned chefs.

facts.text: The concierge team assists with city tours and cultural experiences.
facts.excerpt: Our dedicated Concierge team is always on hand to assist with city tours and cultural experiences.

facts.text: The Salon welcomes Grand Opera Tower guests only.
facts.excerpt: The Salon welcomes Grand Opera Tower guests only, from morning coffee to evening cocktails.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18
